title: HELIX Govern: Data Governance Committee Charter Template
description: Fillable charter template for establishing a Data Governance Council. Institutions customize by replacing bracketed placeholders.

charter.purpose: The Data Governance Council establishes and maintains the policies, standards, and practices that ensure institutional data is accurate, secure, accessible, and used responsibly. The Council adopts the HELIX open framework as its foundational data standard.
charter.authority: The Council operates under the authority of the [Provost / President / CIO]. It has the authority to: (a) set data policies and standards, (b) assign Data Trustees and Stewards, (c) approve classification decisions, (d) approve data sharing agreements, (e) prioritize quality remediation, (f) recommend technology investments.
charter.scope: All institutional data across the 9 HELIX domains: Student Identity, Academic Structure, Enrollment & Registration, Financial Aid, Academic Outcomes, Student Services, Human Resources, Financial Operations, and Advancement & Alumni.

membership.typical_title: VP for Enrollment Management or Registrar

meeting_cadence.annual_review: Annual maturity assessment and charter review

charter.decision_making: Consensus when possible. Chair decides when consensus cannot be reached. Executive Sponsor is escalation authority. Classification and data sharing decisions require a quorum.
responsibilities: Approve and maintain institutional data governance policy
Assign Data Trustees and Stewards to each HELIX domain
Approve data classification for each domain
Approve schema changes and HELIX version adoption
success_metrics: Maturity model score improvement (year over year)
Time to resolve data quality issues
